canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Calis Coror: 36-year-old woman, 163 cm (short), plus-size heavy construction with substantial natural mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: soft rectangular face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; crooked healed nose, balanced mouth; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: one offset razor line. Wardrobe: layered-wrap, specifically overlapping wrap panels, an off-center waist tie, divided trousers, and soft boots; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette marigold-green. Visible personal details: one bounded geometric forearm tattoo; a repaired cuff with bright thread. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
